svg.title: Green Relief over Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-new-paintings-11-2006/lightbox/works/green-relief-over-blue-2004-25970; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
